title: Flow part opener
description: Opens a part of the module: the part's number set large in the monospaced font, a large title and a lead.
instructions: The first screen of a section. number: the part's number on two digits (01, 02…). The title names the part; the body holds one text block with the style lead (one or two sentences on what this part brings).

number.title: Part number
number.description: The part's number, set large above the title (01, 02…).
